name: Immortal Cultivation [ Alpha ]
desc:
🌸 About the Game
Enter a world of Cultivation where power comes through meditation, combat, and mastery.
Inspired by Manhwa and Manhua, blending martial arts and spiritual growth.

⚠️ Testing Phase
The game is still in active development and will receive frequent updates.
What you experience now is just a preview of the full adventure to come.

🎁 Next Code: Unlocks at 4000 likes
💬 Join our community for exclusive codes and news.

✨ Main Feature
🌿 Gather and sell Herbs to earn SpiritStones
⚗️ Practice Alchemy to craft powerful Pills and boost your cultivation
⚔️ Battle mobs to gain SpiritStones and increase your Mastery
🧘 Cultivate and Break Through to advance your Realm
🌌 Meditate in Cultivation Zones to boost your Qi gain
📜 A Skill Manual spawns every 30 minutes (60% chance). Manuals do not despawn.

💻 Controls
C – Cultivate
B – Breakthrough
Shift – Sprint
T – Qi Vision
P – Qi Pressure

Tags: Cultivation, Martial Arts, Alchemy, Manhwa, Manhua, Murim, Progression, Donghua
